turns.assessment: The failure is isolated to svc163 at the ODU/client layer: both endpoints raised simultaneous ODU_TIM and CLIENT_SF, while both underlying lightpaths and all monitored optical spans, amplifiers, and receivers remained stable. S15 is where the two lightpaths are joined, so an svc163 cross-connect misconnection there best explains the bilateral trail mismatch without affecting neighboring services. A switch-fabric failure is contradicted by the many other services through S15 remaining operational.

proposals.rationale: S15 cross-connects svc163 between the S01-S15 and S15-S12 lightpaths. A service-specific misconnection produces ODU_TIM with no optical-layer change and leaves other ODUs intact.
proposals.note: site named; resolved to its node equipment
